title: VPAT remediation: tokens, buttons, tables and charts accessibility fixes
creator: Nora Patel
description:
Scope: Complete VPAT-driven remediation across the design system focusing on color tokens, interactive controls (primary/secondary/ghost buttons), data tables, and charts. Goals: bring contrast ratios to WCAG AA (and where required AAA for small text), ensure keyboard focus/focus-visible on all interactive components, add appropriate ARIA roles/properties for tables and chart semantics, and produce a VPAT appendix documenting pass/fail status and remediation notes.

Outcomes & deliverables: (1) Token updates and a migration guide for product teams (semantic tokens + alias map), (2) Component patches: button focus ring + aria-pressed/aria-expanded semantics where applicable, table keyboard model (arrow navigation, header association, sort buttons with aria-sort), chart accessibility layer (aria-describedby, data table alternative, colorblind palette), (3) Test assets: automated axe/core-a11y tests + manual test checklist, (4) Updated VPAT document and public DS changelog entry.

Prioritization: We are triaging by customer impact and implementation surface: tokens (high priority), buttons (high), tables (medium-high, because many internal dashboards), charts (medium). Expected work split between design (specs & tokens), frontend engineers (implementation), and QA/accessibility engineer (validation).

Acceptance criteria: 
- Color tokens updated and published; migration guide reviewed by at least two product teams.
- All button variants pass keyboard focus and contrast checks (WCAG AA).
- Table component supports keyboard navigation, accessible sort, and screen reader announcements for sorting; documented in component README.
- Charts expose accessible descriptions and alternative data tables; at least one chart palette added for color vision deficiencies.
- VPAT draft updated with remediation notes for each checklist item and attached to the DS Confluence page.

Notes on constraints: Some legacy consumer product pages rely on exact token names — migration must include token alias layer and a deprecation schedule. Chart library (third-party) limits ARIA hooks in v3, so we may need to wrap visuals with an accessible container or upgrade library in a follow-up ticket.
comments: 2026-01-12 - Nora Patel: Created ticket after initial VPAT review flagged multiple failures across tokens, buttons, tables, charts. Consolidating remediation efforts to avoid fragmented PRs.

2026-01-19 - Jorge Alvarez: Quick audit of button variants done. Primary/secondary meet contrast targets when using large tokens; small ghost buttons fail on 12px labels. Proposed adding 14px min font size for ghost or stronger contrast token.

2026-01-22 - Liam Chen (Engineering): Will prototype a focus-visible update that uses outline-offset and prefers user-agent focus if reduced-motion is set. Blocking concern: some product CSS overrides outline styles; will add specificity guard and document the override pattern.

2026-02-02 - Design review: Figma frames for new token palette and button focus states uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/0a1Bexample/DS-VPAT-Remediation. Requesting engineering review for implementation feasibility.

2026-02-11 - Accessibility (external audit): Recommended table keyboard model to follow aria-activedescendant pattern for complex tables, but suggested progressive enhancement to avoid breaking lightweight tables. Action: implement for data-grid variant, keep simple for basic tables.

2026-02-18 - Jorge Alvarez: RFC posted in GitHub module outlining token aliases and migration plan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/214. Initial PR includes token map and tests for color contrast.
2026-03-03 - PM feedback (Anika Rao): Please ensure migration guide includes snippet for sx/css-in-js consumers and the deprecation timeline (90 days + notify via changelog).

2026-03-09 - QA (Eva Morales): Added manual test steps for screen reader announcements when sorting tables; found an edge-case where aria-live was not triggered for client-side table updates. Engineer assigned to patch this in ENG-3190.
2026-03-10 - Jorge Alvarez: Updated acceptance criteria to require automated axe checks in CI for PRs touching DS tokens or components.
acceptance_criteria: Published token set with alias map and migration guide; product teams sign-off.
All button variants meet WCAG AA contrast and keyboard focus requirements.
Table component supports accessible keyboard navigation and sorting announcements; README updated.
Charts include aria-describedby and alternative data representations; one colorblind-friendly palette added.
VPAT document updated and linked on DS Confluence page; remediation notes added for each failing item.
